reviews.name: Jason
reviews.text: Driving home on us1 in Jensen beach/stuart at 4:15pm I was almost hit by a teel electric van.     This guy was cutting cars off over and over where multiple people had to slam on their breaks coming close to causing accidents.  Y’all need to do better at hiring people    I have dash cam video of it all

reviews.name: Sandy M.
reviews.text: A representative from Teel Electric came to our home in NC after Hurricane Florence blow a tree onto our house.  They were very personal and efficient.  In our time of need, they were there to help us when it was difficult to find available skilled workers.  Thank you Teel Electric for going the distance for us!

reviews.name: Jeffrey W.
reviews.text: I have used Teel Electric multiple times on a variety of projects. They’ve installed everything from fans to generators. I’ve hired them to do complete Commerical remodels and repairs on existing buildings. They do a fantastic job and all their staff are professional and have incredible knowledge. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Jennifer N.
reviews.text: This company really knows what they are doing. David came to our house and installed the Lutron radio RA2 system. He was very professional and helpful in answering all my questions. He went above and beyond what he needed to do. If you want someone that cares and does meticulous work call Teel Electric.

reviews.name: scott m.
reviews.text: David Newberry from Teel Electric Company came to our home today to install our new Nest Doorbell. He was very knowledgeable and gave us wonderful user advice. He also made suggestions for future purchases to enhance our Nest. I would recommend David Newberry from Teel Electric without reservation.
